subject: Request for short evaluation buffer while PO clears — Medallion Health
messages:
From: Heather Collins <heather.collins@medallionhealth.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short buffer while PO clears

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the engineering team at Medallion is excited about Redwood's inference performance. We're trapped on our side by procurement / vendor onboarding: finance has routed the PO for approvals and it looks like it might not clear until the end of the month.

We need another week or two of access to keep the evaluation running for the ML team — otherwise the PoC momentum collapses. Is there a way to extend our sandbox or get a small voucher until the PO is finalized?

I can loop in procurement if that's helpful. Our expected PO submission is 2026-05-18, but approvals typically take 7–10 business days after that.

Thanks,
Heather Collins
Director, Platform Engineering
Medallion Health

[Attachment: medallion_po_estimate.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)]

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Heather Collins <heather.collins@medallionhealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short buffer while PO clears

Hi Heather — appreciate the heads up and congrats to your team on the strong feedback.

We can absolutely help keep the PoC alive while procurement finishes the paperwork. I checked with ops and we can provision a 10k-token voucher for your sandbox (equivalent to ~7 days of average exploration) and extend the sandbox expiration by 14 days. To apply this I need a quick confirmation of the expected PO submission date and the primary procurement contact (name + email) so we can document it on our side.

If you’d prefer a larger temporary allowance (short-term burst credits), let me know and I’ll route it for expedited approval — it just takes an extra step with finance. For now I’ve cc'ed Grace (revenue ops) to confirm the voucher and record the commitment.

Next steps:
- Reply with procurement contact + expected PO submission date
- I’ll confirm voucher application and send a short addendum for records

Thanks — looking forward to keeping this moving.

—Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0183

Thanks for looping me in, Mateo.

Approved: we can apply a 10k-token voucher and extend the Medallion sandbox TTL by 14 days. I've attached the internal approval matrix for audit (we keep a copy in the deal folder). Voucher will be applied to the account by EOD today.

Notes/conditions (short):
- Voucher applied to evaluation account: medallion-sbx-8421
- Voucher amount: 10,000 tokens (non-refundable, expires 2026-05-25)
- Extension: sandbox TTL extended to 2026-05-25
- We record procurement timeline in HubSpot; please share procurement contact + anticipated PO submission date.

Marissa — FYI in case we need to ladder any finance exceptions later.

Grace O'Connor
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com

Hi Grace and Mateo — this is great, thank you both.

Procurement contact: Samir Patel <samir.patel@medallionhealth.com>. Expected internal PO submission: 2026-05-18. If approvals run long we'll escalate inside our finance team but hopeful this will be enough to keep the ML team running the tests.

We received the voucher notice in the sandbox and verified the extended TTL — really appreciate the quick turn. I’ll follow up with a short note to Samir so he has your contact info for any billing questions.

Best,
Heather
Director, Platform Engineering
Medallion Health
